title: Mecha Marauders
summary: Go from trashy to thrashy in this reverse tower defense!
html:
Welcome to the world of Mecha Marauders. We are super excited to have you thrash around in this early build.

Go from Trashy to Thrashy in this Trashpunk Reverse Tower Defense Puzzler. Instead of bolstering your defenses to fend off enemy waves, MECHA MARAUDERS has you engineering an upcycled army from rubbish and refuse to overthrow an evil technocracy! I mean, aren’t we ALL ready to scrap our Data Lords?

The game is played in two phases: first you customize your mech units , and then you deploy those units into the Scrapyard to see how far they can get. Your objective is to destroy as many enemy towers as possible and to reach checkpoints that unlock more components and resources for customization.

The game is mostly driven by AI, you don’t need to control your units at all. Simply select where to spawn them and they will autopath forwards. If enemy turrets are within range, your mechs will attack them. But be careful: Those turrets shoot back!

title: The Emerald Path
summary: Shield the Forest, Break the Invaders
html:
The Emerald Path is a topdown Tower Defense game where you attempt to stave off the fierce invaders by wielding a combination of your own unique units and spells.

Each unit and spell costs light, so choose your strategy carefully!

title: Dungeon Royale
summary: A Clash Royale Clone implemented during IGA's Level 2 course
html:
outDungeon Royale was built during the Indie Game Academy’s Level 2 Course. Much thanks to Rick, Trev, the IGA staff, and my classmates for all the help and learning!

There isn’t much beyond the coursework itself, except some health bars, slightly more interactive buttons, and a bunch of dungeon themed things.

Before shipping i tuned down most of the AI, so it should be pretty easy to win! The player units are much more powerful than the enemy ones, and the enemy doesn’t spawn very quickly.

title: Neon & Chrome
summary: Strategize, outmaneuver, and annihilate the enemy's base to secure victory in this adrenaline-pumping battle for supremacy.
html:
Step into the futuristic world of ‘Neon & Chrome’, where corporations battle for control through intense robot proxy wars.

Command three unique unit types: Strikers, Shockers, and Blades, each with their own specialized abilities. Use Strikers to punch through enemy defenses, Shockers to electrify your opponents from a distance, and Blades to slice through foes with precision.

Strategize, outmaneuver, and annihilate the enemy’s base to secure victory in this adrenaline-pumping battle for supremacy.

title: Phoenix Royale
summary: A simple, fast-paced Clash Royale style game
html:
This project was created over the course of approximately four weeks as a learning exercise for Indie Game Academy’s Level 2 course.

My goal was to create a simplified version of Clash Royale, with an emphasis on meaningful unit dynamics and interactions. Certain units are intended to counter others, so choose wisely based on what the AI plays against you.

title: Skeleton Royale
summary: Destroy the sepulcher of the skeleton to dispel the tree's hold and reclaim the burial ground.
html:
Drag and drop thy brethren to the fore of the church for its safeguarding. Thou can not battle in solitude- observe thy lord’s spiritual vigor recharge. Accumulate spiritual might to summon more potent warriors. Destroy the sepulcher of the skeleton to dispel the tree’s hold and reclaim the burial ground.

Heed this counsel: The devils horns yield a heavy blow.

An exercise recreating a custom version of Clash Royale in Unity with IGA. Faux mobile game with randomly generating enemies.

summary: Welcome to Janni's Jinxed Journey, a game where you play a stealthy little witch trying to unseat a necromancer Governor in the age of piracy. Note: the Web version is fully playable… but it has many
html:
Welcome to Janni’s Jinxed Journey, a game where you play a stealthy little witch trying to unseat a necromancer Governor in the age of piracy.

Note: the Web version is fully playable… but it has many hiccups that occur due to the format. If you want the more complete version, try the windows version.

Controls

WASD Movement
Spacebar Jump Press Spacebar while airborn to toggle glide
E Talk to NPC, select Yes/No, advance dialog.
Left Mouse Button Sleep Spell (works if NPC is unaware of you)

Health

The Dragonfly over Janni’s left shoulder indicates her health: green for healthy, yellow for low, and red for very low

Water

Janni can’t swim, and her magic will teleport her to the last place she was standing before jumping in the water.

Stealth: Light

Guards can only see Janni in the light. The indicator at the top of the screen indicates how hidden she is and how alert the guards are:

Black:  Hidden, no guard knows where Janni is.

Purple: Known, the guards are looking for Janni.

Orange: Spotted, a guard can see Janni

Bushes provide cover, and when in hidden (black) can protect her from the light.

summary: Explore a fantastical island where fantastical new creatures await! Run, jump, and glide your way to discover new animals to photograph and become the next great Emergent Organism Researcher in this s
html:
Explore the newly discovered island of Anakalys where new species of creatures, called Emergent Organisms, now roam freely! The island awaits!

An open-world island

Welcome to Anakalys, an island seemingly born from the mists! You play as the Rookie Resarcher, a newbie looking to make their name as a researcher in the modern age of exploration. Dr. Cooper, a legend-turned-hermit researcher, discovered this mysterious island, and he wants YOU to research its inhabitants! In this single-player open-world exploration game, you’ll journey the island yourself!

Anakalys is home to a vibrant jungle environment, the perfect home for an exceptionally cute selection of animals to roam about. Additionally, Anakalysis is home to a unique phenomena of floating chunks of land, which may lead you to new places…

title: You Will Crash!
summary: A retro arcade inspired racer!
html:
This is a full-featured game featuring 24 tracks and no ads!

——————–

2187: RACING IS DEAD. The art of driving is a gray wash on a dull canvas.

ACE DRIVERS in the underbelly of NEON LAGOON take old hotrods from the clutches of CARBOR CORPORATION and race them through Artificial Intelligence-controlled Highways, Construction Zones, and the mind-bending landscapes of NEON LAGOON; all to prove themselves the fastest racer.

Use the CARBOR-branded BOOST panels to increase your SPEED. Attain MASTERY over the tracks around NEON LAGOON.

Get ready to race, and never forget what the infamous racers of NEON LAGOON claim: “YOU WILL CRASH!”

——————–

In this retro, arcade-inspired hectic lane changer, race through NEON LAGOON. Your vehicle gains speed every successful lap, allowing you to claim a faster and faster time.

Watch out! You will face obstacles and on-coming vehicle traffic as you race through the vaporwave & synthwave aesthetic inspired canvas that makes up the landscape of NEON LAGOON, with amazing jumps, loops, and more. When you crash you lose speed, and if you crash too many times, your race is over!

Race against yourself and beat your best times, unlocking more tracks as you progress. Play regularly to unlock special bounty tracks that only unlock at special times!

– Easy-to-use touch controls make this a quick game to learn

– Race your car through 24 tracks in the NEON LAGOON landscape

– Use boost panels to increase your speed!

– Gain more speed each lap!

– Save your best lap speeds in order to race against yourself!

– Avoid on-coming traffic – if you get hit you slow down!

– Get into too many crashes and its GAME OVER!

– Thrilling music and sound effects

– Amazing 3D visuals, camera effects, and incredible graphics

– This is a full-featured game with hours of content and no ads!

——————–

Race in NEON LAGOON and prove yourself the best racer!

——————–

Developer: Nicholas Gurley

summary: What heights would you go to save the ones you love?
html:
WARNING: This game contains flashing lights and shaking camera movements, which may not be suitable for those who are photosensitive or are prone to motion sickness

———————————————————–

What heights would you go to save the ones you love?

Kenna’s life has been fraught with suffering after raids and ruin have befallen her people.  Now, there is nowhere to go but up.  However, there is one insurmountable problem–Kenna is afraid of heights.

Can the young girl climb the great mountain, Store Kaldrhvalrtind, and find the legendary magic at the peak?  Will she fall from the high cliffs and faces of the snowy summit into pits and perils below?  Or, will she give in to the fear and despair long before the fall?  This is Kenna’s Climb.

How to Play:

  • Use WASD to move Kenna
  • Press SPACE to jump
  • Hold W to move up climbable surfaces
  • Press Q to reduce fear after picking up a calming tea
  • Press R to restart at the last checkpoint
